name: cludegods
description: CludeGods: voice calls, always-on workers, Spaces and a Slack bridge for Claude Code, as desktop mods

plugins.name: workers-pane
plugins.description: The Workers pane: your standing worker chats as god cards with status, an Ask field, hours, an outbox to approve, activity, and settings

plugins.name: spaces-pane
plugins.description: The Spaces pane: Markdown spaces and pages you and your workers share, with drafts that land only after your approval

plugins.name: inbox-relay
plugins.description: Hands messages from the Slack bridge to the right worker chat
